gaps.valueSet: Rule 5 specimen-dependent and caseating-granuloma test branches
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no laboratory specimen-type predicate, and the source marks both caseating-granuloma test-name value sets not implemented with no codes; TUB-R5 retains the tissue-specific test-name alternatives that do not require specimen matching
the source marks the ICD10CM value set not implemented with no codes; TUB-R11 retains the authoritative SNOMED diagnosis and active-problem alternatives
the source marks the panel value set not implemented with no codes; TUB-R19 retains the individual-test alternative

gaps.valueSet: Rules 20 and 21 imaging result and reason-for-study evidence
gaps.reason: the source marks both rules inoperable because imaging interpretations and reasons are narrative text; SEM_V1 has no imaging-result or imaging-order-reason evidence, so both rules are omitted

SEM_V1 represents laboratory test-name evidence but does not distinguish a completed result observation from an order; the curated rules preserve the source test-name sets and document this limitation
SEM_V1 medication evidence does not distinguish initiation or administration from other recorded medication evidence; the curated rules preserve the source medication value sets and cardinality
the source identifies death-certificate evidence, but SEM_V1 has no death-certificate evidence
